Each accent arrow points from a parent to a child it discovered, and numbered badges give the discovery order. The card maps A to its children B and C, and C to D; the leaves B and D are not keys." width="100%"} The reverse view of `bfs_predecessors()`: for each node of the breadth-first search tree from `source` that has children, the list of nodes discovered from it. It shows how the search fans out, level by level, such as who first heard a rumor from whom. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [source]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The start node, as an ID or label. [depth_limit]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional maximum depth. [mode]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["out"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Edge direction to follow on directed graphs: `"out"` (default), `"in"` or `"all"`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict[int, list[int]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Parent node ID to the list of its children, in discovery order (leaves are not keys, except the source, which maps to an empty list when it has no children). ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the source does not exist or `mode` is invalid. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} Grouped from the tree edges of `bfs_edges()`. Matches NetworkX's `bfs_successors`. ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#e97d6b2a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph().add_nodes(["A", "B", "C", "D"]) g.add_edges([("A", "B"), ("A", "C"), ("C", "D")]) {g.get_label_from_id(p): [g.get_label_from_id(c) for c in cs] for p, cs in g.bfs_successors("A").items()} ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {'A': ['B', 'C'], 'C': ['D']} ``` ::: :::
